title: Line Item
description: Line item object. Expected to use the currency of the parent object.

id.description: Session-scoped line item identifier. Under full replacement on update, an echoed id is preserved on the resulting line, an omitted id is minted as a new line, and an unknown or duplicate id returns a recoverable error.

modifications.description: List of modifications selected for the dish on this line item.

note.description: Buyer-specified freeform note for the kitchen on this line item. Passed verbatim; MUST NOT alter price or structured modifications.

quantity.description: Quantity of the dish being purchased.
